A '''copper helmet''' is a [[Armor#Helmet|helmet]] of the [[Copper equipment|copper]] tier, crafted from five [[copper ingot]]s. It gives 2 armor points and is the base for the [[Shakudo Helmet|shakudo]] and [[hepatizon helmet]]s.

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

== Usage ==

=== Armor ===
The copper helmet gives 2 armor and has 200 durability, against 121 for the vanilla copper helmet. It is as protective as the [[iron helmet]] but wears out sooner.

=== Warding ===
Copper armor protects undead from [[Warding]]. While any non-player entity wearing at least one piece of plain copper armor (not shakudo or hepatizon) is within warding range, warding at levels 1 to 3 targets that entity instead, deals no damage and does not slow it. Only level 4 warding, from the full [[Electrum equipment|electrum]] set bonus, pierces this and damages the wearer. [[Warding stone]]s ignore copper armor entirely.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/enchantment_effects/warding/power_1.mcfunction}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/enchantment_effects/warding/power_4.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[copper ingot]]s. As with all equipment in the pack, the repair cost never grows, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting and smithing ===
{{Uses}}

In a [[blast furnace]], it melts down into one copper ingot.

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|1.10|Undead wearing copper armor became immune to [[Warding]].}}
{{History line|1.12.2|Warding now targets copper-wearing mobs (and armor stands) before other undead, so copper armor draws warding away from nearby undead.}}
